title: Shinonome Akito — Tag Terror〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, there he is! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's rare for you to arrive last, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you're usually here first out of everyone to practice on your own.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was going to today too, but a few things came up...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You being vague like that is just as strange.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I was gonna do this after practice, but I guess now also works...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, but there's something I need to ask you guys regarding tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Tomorrow? Is this about our meeting at COL?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I may run a little late.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... That should be fine, since all we're going to talk about tomorrow is flyers and advertising.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Honestly, only Azusawa and I absolutely need to be there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm just there to check over the equipment, so you don't necessarily have to be there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I'm a part of the team, so I should be there if I can...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, be sure to let us know if you're going to be late. I'll relay that to the owner.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, it is kinda weird to see you asking a favor of us like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Does it have to do with why you arrived late today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're participating in a disc dog competition?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Not so loud, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
I couldn't contain my surprise.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah, I'm just as surprised.
I can't believe you're taking that owner's place after just meeting him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, that's not what Toya was talking about.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I kinda get why you feel like you need to compete in his place.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You said Max is this guy's partner, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Our dream is to become the number one team in the country!

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Right, partner?!

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've been seeing them work really hard towards making their dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So I felt that I had to do this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so nice of you, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I just couldn't leave things be.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! That's what it means to be a nice person.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Again, that wasn't my intent...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Still, Akito, are you sure about this...?
I mean, you and dogs don't really...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd be lying if I said I'm sure...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But like I said, Kamishiro and a few others have agreed to lend me a hand.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, I plan on keeping my commitment.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, Akito, you focus on the competition. We'll handle the meeting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, since you're doing this, it'd be great to cheer you on until we have to go to that meeting. Can we come watch?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not. A. Chance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Boo...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to show my support as well, but I'd rather not have us run late...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure he'll be fine since Minori and the others are gonna be there with him. We should focus on what we have to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry for taking up so much time...
Anyway, let's start practicing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's get started!
